display_name: DURA 留一视图教师 GPU 训练
description: 冻结 DURA，多尺度修正训练时使用同一源记录另外两视图的 DURA 输出均值作为教师。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU4 deterministic FP32 TF32off source training; CPU ground

data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 672 fixed previously explored source L_s/U_s IQ, not independent of DURA

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA and newly initialized 117062-parameter zero-head multiscale correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA source-only; source context exact ordered 32768 fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA and fixed source IQ context have no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final epoch five fixed in advance; no target or pilot-based selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU4; wait for >=4096 MiB free and fewer than 3 total compute apps; preserve other jobs
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.method: DURA correction with the other two source-view DURA outputs as teacher
rows.purpose: Source IQ guard plus cross-view teacher consistency
rows.seed_notes: Correction initialization 2026110612; source fit ID selection 2026110611; training order 2026110613; evaluation 2026092701
rows.budget_ref: 117062 trainable correction parameters plus frozen DURA; 32768 source IDs x 3 views x 5 epochs, batch32

notes: Frozen DURA plus multiscale correction; source loss = original DURA guard + 0.5 teacher IQ error.
For each source view the teacher averages DURA outputs of the other two aligned views of the same source record; no independence assumed.
Fit 32768 permitted source IDs with three simulated views and fixed five epochs; no F/TX/V/target reads.
Inference uses only current IQ and DURA, never other views or the training teacher.
Frozen candidate must complete 168000 x seven Phase1 Main split views with fixed Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and independent truth-last scoring.
GPU4 capacity queue preserves all other owners; source IQ teacher gains do not imply identity improvement.
